meta.title: About ONDE, a Tunisian startup · The film | ONDE
meta.description: ONDE (onde.tn) is a Tunisian startup helping businesses get more Google reviews with NFC. Watch the 41-second film and see how it works.

why.body: It isn't bad will. Search for the business, find the listing, scroll, sign in, write: there are too many steps between "that was great" and five published stars. Meanwhile, the one unhappy customer always finds the time to write.

steps.title: Tap.
steps.body: Your customer holds their phone to the ONDE product. No app, no search, no account to create.

steps.title: Review.
steps.body: Your Google review page opens instantly. Five stars, two lines, posted.

steps.title: Grow.
steps.body: More reviews, a better rating, a higher spot on Google Maps. And more customers walking in.

how.phonesBody: NFC works on iPhone XR, XS and newer and on NFC-enabled Android phones. For everyone else, a QR code leads to the same smart link.
how.illoTap: A phone taps the ONDE stand and NFC waves ripple out
how.illoReview: The Google review page opens and five stars fill in
how.illoGrow: The business climbs to the top of the list

link.body: Every ONDE product carries one permanent link, written to the chip only once. Google reviews today, your menu tonight, Instagram tomorrow: the destination is switched remotely in seconds. No reprint. No new chip.
link.futureBody: Same chip, same link — new destinations whenever you're ready.

tunisia.body: ONDE (onde.tn) is a Tunisian startup serving businesses across the country. We program every product, deliver it, and stay reachable afterwards — because a link that keeps working for years deserves real care.

pillars.title: Local support
pillars.body: A real team, reachable 7 days a week on WhatsApp.
